description: This file defines the S3EndpointMiddleware class, which manages the customization of endpoint URLs for AWS S3 requests to support features like Accelerate and DualStack. It includes methods for determining and applying the correct endpoint pattern based on command options and request details.

classes.name: S3EndpointMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware used to modify S3 request endpoints for support of features like accelerate and dualstack, ensuring requests are routed to the correct AWS endpoints based on configuration.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method that creates a wrapper function to instantiate the middleware with provided configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with handler, region, options, and endpoint provider.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware to modify the request based on endpoint pattern decision logic.

methods.name: endpointPatternDecider
methods.description: Determines the appropriate endpoint pattern (host style, path style, dualstack, accelerate) based on command options and request compatibility.

methods.name: canAccelerate
methods.description: Checks whether the accelerate endpoint feature can be used for the given command.

methods.name: applyHostStyleEndpoint
methods.description: Modifies the request URI to use host style endpoint with bucket name as subdomain.

methods.name: applyPathStyleEndpointCustomizations
methods.description: Adjusts request URI for path style endpoint, especially for object lambda responses.

methods.name: applyDualStackEndpoint
methods.description: Modifies request to use dualstack endpoint hostname.

methods.name: getDualStackHost
methods.description: Constructs the dual-stack hostname based on region and DNS suffix.

methods.name: applyAccelerateEndpoint
methods.description: Applies accelerate endpoint modifications to the request URI.

methods.name: getAccelerateHost
methods.description: Constructs the accelerate hostname based on bucket and DNS suffix.

methods.name: getBucketlessPath
methods.description: Removes the bucket segment from the path, used for certain endpoint patterns.

methods.name: applyEndpoint
methods.description: Finalizes applying a specific endpoint configuration to the request, handling ARN and custom endpoint cases.
